scope: Source-only static + deterministic hoard; excludes dynamically derived heroic variants; not imported into HIGHFLY
notes: Metadata is a lightweight static audit of code, not a live runtime reconciliation.
Original source names are audit-only and must be translated/replaced with original HIGHFLY names before gameplay.
Any source art/audio/model requires independent file-specific license verification; all marked blocked by default.
No record implies the object is equipable, craftable, droppable or visually available in HIGHFLY.
Generated heroic item variants are not counted.
